summary: Client rules use server-issued claims, strict profile ownership and bounded field validation. Workflow writes are server-only; public-campus read scope is intentional. Emulator validation is required alongside callable checks. Production release needs institution-specific admission and abuse protection.

findings.issue: Students may edit their own academic metadata; department and year are personalization fields, not verified admission or confidentiality boundaries.
findings.recommendation: Verify institutional membership through a trusted admission process before using academic metadata for restricted resources.
